title: Speech interaction (STT, intent, TTS)
purpose: Enable hands-light, fully spoken interaction: push-to-talk speech input, deterministic intent parsing, and prioritised speech output.
architecturalScope: Accessibility bounded context. SpeechInputPort, SpeechOutputPort and IntentParser. Local-first, cloud optional and interchangeable.
domainContext: Observation<string>, Intent, Confidence. Interaction state owned by the Assistant Orchestrator.

milestones.title: Deterministic intent parsing
milestones.description: Rule/slot-based intents with fuzzy product queries.

milestones.title: Prioritised, interruptible TTS
milestones.description: Speech output coordinated with screen readers.

tasks.title: Benchmark local STT engines (Vosk, sherpa-onnx, Web Speech)
acceptanceCriteria: WER measured in quiet and noisy conditions.

tasks.title: Implement local STT adapter with push-to-talk
Implement rule-based intent parser
acceptanceCriteria: Intent accuracy > 95% on the command test set.

tasks.title: Implement TTS adapter with priority and interruption
acceptanceCriteria: No overlapping unintelligible output with the screen reader.
Cloud ASR is optional, visible and never required.
Audio is processed ephemerally and never stored.

risks.mitigation: Push-to-talk, domain grammar, optional cloud fallback.

safetyImplications: Misheard commands must trigger confirmation for consequential actions.
accessibilityImplications: Speech is the primary modality; it must not depend on any visual fallback.
privacyImplications: Microphone audio is processed ephemerally; cloud use is explicit opt-in.

decisionLog.decision: Scope reduced to post-MVP speech extension; the MVP uses todo.speech-product-request and todo.spoken-guidance.
decisionLog.rationale: docs/15-mvp-priority.md: keep MVP scope on the closed loop.
